scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix frontend ci
scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix backend run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix backend run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix frontend run test && npm --prefix backend run test:run
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
